question: What capacity retention did the aqueous-processed and the NMP-processed NMC 811 pouch cells show?
rendered:
Document title: Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries

The aqueous-processed NMC 811 cells showed a capacity retention of about 70% after long-term cycling, while the NMP-processed cells showed a capacity retention of about 76%. (page 5)
